description: This Java class defines the User entity model for a book tracking application. It encompasses user attributes such as email, password, account status, roles, and includes metadata annotations for ORM, validation, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user account with fields for credentials, status, roles, and account security features, configured for persistence and validation.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare Users based on email address for logical equality.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on email address.
